notes.title: Feedback
notes.content:
First off, I want to thank all of you for your feedback. It is all welcome, however negative it may be. Negative feedback helps us grow as developers.

I agree with all of you that we set the price of the game too high. $9.99 was too much to ask for this game, and TAKEN is now undergoing a pending price change. When approved, it will sell for $1.99.

Secondly, I was just too excited to get the game out into the marketplace that I jumped the gun and released a game with some bugs in it. If you do wish to purchase the game, it does have some issues with framerate on the first world, "Thicket", as well as some menus having improper text.

This was my first PC game; up until this point I'd only developed apps for mobile, so I only have room to grow. Again I'd like to thank all of you for providing honest feedback, as that is the only way that I can learn from my mistakes and get better at making games.
